limitations.note: The rewrite corrected zero detection during normal operation but removed the existing one-cycle output delay and changed the reset value of `zero` from 0 to 1.
The passing test assumed both the rewrite's immediate count and set timing and its asserted reset flag, so it could not catch either regression.
